_comment: macOS: the MSI controller of crosvm's MBI SPIs (package/DroidVMGicMsi.cpp, from Droid-VM/macOS-DroidVM) on /arm-io/gic-mbi, the interrupt parent of Apple's PCIe bridge AppleVirtualPlatformPCIE on /arm-io/pcie (both nodes made by DarwinBoot from the FDT). The bridge's own personality wants an AppleARMIODevice nub; ArmDTPlatform's arm-io nubs are IOPlatformDevice. Also DroidVMVirtioPCI (package/DroidVMVirtioPciNub.cpp), which holds the virtio-pci functions the board's own drivers serve -- by PCI id, at a probe score above Apple's AppleVirtIOPCITransport, which matches every 0x1af4 function and whose probe sets its score to 10000 -- and publishes each one's place for its driver's kext (the input kext: DroidVMVirtioPciWatch.cpp), which starts later. Here, beside the MSI controller the PCIe bridge needs anyway, because a kext of its own did not fit the collection's __DATA. 0x1052: virtio-input.
name: DroidVMGicMsi
